appearance.hair: White, neck-length bob haircut with straight, slightly parted piecey bangs and longer side strands framing her face. HEAD_UNIT_01 mechanical ear sensor units are mounted on top of her head. A square black hair clip with a glowing cyan paw print is worn on her right side (viewer's left).
appearance.face: Anime-style youthful face with fair skin, large bright blue eyes with detailed irises, black eyelashes and eyeliner, thin eyebrows, light blush on the cheeks, and a happy open-mouthed smile.
appearance.body: Slender, fair-skinned female humanoid wearing form-fitting high-tech mechanical armor.
appearance.outfit: Futuristic form-fitting mechanical bodysuit in white and black with glowing cyan light accents. The right shoulder armor plate is white, decorated with a cyan paw print logo and a cyan '02' number decal underneath. The suit has a high collar and black harness-like structural straps across the chest.

equipment.headUnit: HEAD_UNIT_01: fully mechanical head-mounted ear sensor units. Rigid white armor shells with smooth pink inner panels and cyan glow accents. Hard-surface robotics — no fur, no biological cat ears.
equipment.earUnit: Mechanical ear sensor units (HEAD_UNIT_01). Rigid white shells, articulated at the base, rendered as smooth mechanical surfaces, never as furry animal ears.
equipment.tailUnit: TAIL_UNIT_02: segmented robotic tail composed of articulated white armor segments with cyan joint lights, connected to the rear waist connection port. No fur, not an organic tail.
equipment.connectionPort: Rear waist connection port: mechanical docking port on the lower back where TAIL_UNIT_02 attaches.
